# The Asteroid — the lines (generated by Tools/Voice/make_asteroid_lines.py from Docs/CHAPTER_ASTEROID.md)

Voices: 7 = Seven (Eleven v3, performance notes as audio tags) · Panther = Cat (telepathic treatment in Unity) · Machinist = Dan's saved voice "Machinist" · System = a premade ElevenLabs voice (`Tools/Voice/generate_asteroid_voices.py`). Files: `Unity/Assets/Resources/AsteroidVoice/<id>.mp3`. Ids ending in a letter + digit (`_P1`) are the chat's proposed lines.

## AST_05 — Keeping the wrong thing alive

| id | speaker | line | direction |
|---|---|---|---|

| `AST_05_02` | Panther | The archive feed goes directly to the foundry. |  |
| `AST_05_03` | 7 | Can we stop it? |  |
| `AST_05_04` | Panther | The whole foundry? Not safely. It also powers the stabilizers. | Measured |
| `AST_05_05` | 7 | All right. Just the archive line. |  |
| `AST_05_06` | Panther | There’s a maintenance bypass. Three local controls. |  |
| `AST_05_07` | 7 | Of course there are. | Sigh, followed by a small laugh |
| `AST_05_08` | Panther | Would you prefer four? | Dry |
| `AST_05_09` | 7 | Don’t encourage it. |  |

| `AST_05_10` | Panther | You've done that before. | Quiet |
| `AST_05_11` | 7 | I… don't know. |  |
| `AST_05_P2` | Panther | Security machines. They want to escort you somewhere. | Wry |

|---|---|---|---|
